The '''Kamino submarine''' was a type of submersible vehicle used on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].

==Characteristics==
The [[Submarine/Legends|submarine]] could be piloted by one person, and was equipped with an emergency escape system. The pilot would simply eject using the central cockpit fuselage.

==History==
[[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used one such submarine to investigate wreckage from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] [[Warship/Legends|warships]] that crashed into the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] during the [[Battle of Kamino/Legends|Battle of Kamino]]. He then used the escape system when the submarine was attacked by [[Aqua droid/Legends|aqua droids]], which emerged from the wreckages.
